hero.eyebrow: Fantasy · Science Fantasy · Slice of Life
hero.title: Stories about people learning how to live again.
hero.lede: Reincarnation, isekai, and the quiet, unglamorous work of rebuilding a life — told through people who are imperfect, lost, and trying anyway.

works.title: Three stories, one question
works.lede: Each begins differently — a second life, a wrong world, a body that isn't yours — but all of them ask the same thing: what does it take to actually live, not just survive?

writing.title: What's alive on the desk right now

quote.text: "I believe stories deserve endings. Some of mine span years; others are written short and focused, on purpose — so I can keep learning how to bring a narrative to a close I actually believe in."
quote.attrib: — Rae ARK, on why The Shadow I Cast Over Two Beautiful Flowers exists
